Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
Black Hole's Evil Twin - Gravastars Explained

Black holes are the most mysterious and extreme objects in the universe—where physics itself breaks down. In this playlist, we explore the mind-bending science of black holes and the bizarre phenomena surrounding them. What happens if you fall into one? Is information truly lost forever, or does the paradox have an answer? Dive into strange ideas like black hole bombs, gravastars, and hypothetical black hole stars. We’ll take you beyond the event horizon, into the realm of neutron stars and strange matter, where the rules of reality begin to blur. Discover the power of quasars—the brightest beacons of the cosmos—and meet the largest black holes known, monsters millions of times the mass of our Sun. From the terrifying to the theoretical, this series is a journey to the edge of space, time, and understanding.
